boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 89 opens with a mixed top shelf over two stacked chambers. Strip that shelf first, drain the `6` chamber next, and then clear the keyed left lane plus the orange columns before the `11` chamber gives way to the red T-shaped endgame.
landmarks: Block Out Level 89 opens with a mixed top shelf over two stacked chambers.
Strip that shelf first, drain the `6` chamber next, and then clear the keyed left lane plus the orange columns before the `11` chamber gives way to the red T-shaped endgame.
The board mixes Purple, Green, Red and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: If the top shelf still has live blue or green pieces, the `11` chamber is not ready.
The keyed yellow lane on the left matters more than the raw `11` count.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Remove the mixed strips on the top shelf, especially the blue row and the green block on the upper-right.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Start shrinking the upper `6` chamber only after the top shelf has stopped feeding blockers downward.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Leave the lower `11` chamber alone until the `6` chamber is nearly gone.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: After the upper chamber opens the board, clear the keyed yellow lane on the left and shorten the orange columns around the center.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Let the `11` chamber collapse only when the red T-shape and the two blue pools underneath it have room to separate.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Finish with the red T-piece, the last orange column, and the remaining yellow L-block near the lower-left corner.

failurePoints: Touching the `11` chamber while the top shelf still has live blue or green traffic.
Ignoring the keyed left lane and trying to brute-force the lower half after the `6` chamber opens.
